releases.notes:
## Fixes

- **Train Detector settings were not saved.** Changing the activation range (nodes), the seconds offset or the "Use
  Seconds Offset" toggle and closing the screen had no effect: the range always went back to 6. The server looked up the
  player's world by a method name that only exists in development builds, so in released jars it found no world and
  dropped the settings. The same lookup also broke applying a brush profile to a rail with MTR's brush.
- **Camera tilt on tilted rails** never applied in released jars (same cause: the rotation was looked up by name).
- **Dashboard map tiles** rendered empty in released jars: the block map colours and the world's bottom height were
  looked up by name. Worlds below y = 0 (1.18+) are now drawn from their real bottom.
- **`/magic` server command replies** (eg the dashboard auth code) were not shown to the player or the console.

releases.notes: # Version 1.4.0 ### Updates ### **Major changes** - Added **Cron timetables**, allowing depots to run services using cron expressions and individual time zones. - Rebuilt **Alternative Platforms** with a new selection menu, automatic platform reservations, train diversions and support for rerouting trains held at signals. - Updated PIDS boards to display diverted trains at their actual platforms, including MTR's departure times, delays and destinations. - Added collapsible alternative platform menus to the route selector. - Introduced **Railway Crossings**, featuring animated warning lights, realistic Polish crossing models, five selectable bell sounds and axle counters placed directly on rails. - Added a new **Crossing Linker** with start node, end node and object linking modes, including visual connection previews and MTR brush-based connection displays. - Added support for future crossing equipment, including barrier gates. - Introduced three new route types: **Regional, Intercity and Trolleybus**, with dedicated buttons, translations, System Map icons and dashboard filter colours. ### **Major fixes** - Fixed compatibility issues with JCM resource packs by updating the Fabric Loader build target. - Fixed timetable calculations to respect siding speed limits and update immediately when speed, acceleration or deceleration settings change. - Improved delay-based cancellations, including trains stuck at signals, persistent cancellations after restarts and more reliable delay detection. - Fixed diverted trains being incorrectly cancelled when departing alternative platforms. - Fixed overlapping depot and siding screen controls, and buttons disappearing after window resizing. - Restored rail rotation rendering and fixed System Map icons, CJK names and selected rail connector icons. - Fixed dashboard filters for train type, usage, gauge and electrification, along with route type reporting. - Fixed axle counter and level crossing item textures, icons and translation keys. - Removed the obsolete Ferry route type. ### **Performance improvements** - Optimized axle counter train detection by sharing train position updates across counters. - Improved train detector performance with indexed lookups instead of repeated path scans. - Added spatial indexing for rail tilt lookups and throttled dashboard rail merges. - Optimized riding-car roll calculations and changed MTR's file loader to use a bounded thread pool. **October 25, 2026**
